confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Rimini's July beach-resort pricing; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Restaurant and bar anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely by distance from the seafront. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the beer anchor and typical Italian bar pricing, because direct knowledge is weaker. FX: the 0.6955 rate was taken from the search summary of the RBA exchange rates overview page for 2026-10-15. The RBA page itself was not opened, and a secondary aggregator reported 0.6947 for 2026-10-16, so verify against the official RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Adriatic Riviera resort towns in Emilia-Romagna and the Marche (such as Riccione and Cesenatico) and mainland Italian coastal resorts during peak summer season.
